shares.title: Sharing
shares.subtitle: Read-only links so anyone can browse a form's submissions, with no Kobo or KoboManager account.
shares.bulkFieldHint: One link will be created per value of this field. Single-choice fields (select_one) only.
shares.bulkNoFields: This form has no single-choice (select_one) fields. Sync its schema or use another form.
shares.bulkValuesHint: Tick the values to create a link for. The number in parentheses is their submission count.
shares.bulkTooMany: At most {max} links per batch. Deselect some.
shares.label: Internal name (optional)
shares.exposeAttachmentsNeedsPassword: Exposing attachments requires protecting the link with a password.
shares.exposeReviewSummaryHint: Shows review progress by team/enumerator (aggregate counts; no submission data).
shares.exposeSampleHint: Shows sample compliance by team (aggregate done/target and surveys awaiting review; no submission data).
shares.passwordOptional: Optional. Blank = access via the URL token only.
shares.passwordRequired: This server requires a password on links.
shares.expiresHint: Blank = no expiry. You can always revoke it manually.
shares.scopeStatusHint: Restricts the list, map, detail, attachments and statistics to that review status. The “Review summary”, if exposed, is not trimmed: its purpose is to show the full progress.
shares.scopeTeamsHint: Only checked teams are included in the link. All checked = no restriction.
shares.empty: You haven't created any links yet.
shares.emptyBody: A public read-only link lets you share submissions, the map or statistics with people without an account — with optional password and expiry, scoped by rows and columns.
shares.confirmRevoke: The link will stop working immediately. Continue?
shares.confirmDelete: The link and its stats will be removed. This cannot be undone.

share.loadError: This link is invalid or has expired.
share.passwordPrompt: Enter the password to view the data.
share.reviewDesc: Aggregate counts of every submission in this link, by review status.
share.scopeApprovedNote: This link shows approved submissions only.
share.loadError: Could not load. Check your connection and try again in a moment.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.subtitle: Assign which forms each user can view, edit or validate.
permissions.adminsHidden: Administrators are not listed: they have full access and these permissions do not apply to them.
permissions.colSettingsHint: Can edit this form's settings (team breakdown and quality control thresholds). Does not include deleting it.
permissions.colSampleHint: Can edit this form's sample plan. Includes the Settings permission.
permissions.colsIntro: Tick the fields this user must NOT see. They are hidden from the table, detail, statistics, search and export.
permissions.colsNoFields: This form has no fields yet (sync its schema).
permissions.colsLoadError: Could not load the form fields
permissions.colsReadonlyHint: “Read-only” only affects users with edit permission.

rowfilter.intro: Only submissions matching the filter will be shown. Combine conditions with AND/OR within each group and across groups.
rowfilter.noFilter: No filter: all submissions of the form are shown. Add a group to start.
rowfilter.loadError: Could not load the form fields
